summary: Chase Issuance Trust filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.25 billion Class A(2026-1) note issuance backed by credit card receivables, with J.P. Morgan as sole lead bookrunner. The notes carry a 4.40% coupon, price to public of 99.97634%, and have a scheduled principal payment date of May 15, 2029. This is a routine asset-backed securitization takedown, not a special situation. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), with no corporate control change, strategic event, or transformative transaction. There is no risk-arb angle; investors should monitor credit performance of the underlying receivables pool.
